description: Add to or take from the cook's pantry. Pass what they said in `text`, as they said it, however messy: a comma list, a dictated ramble ("um I've got like 2 lbs of chicken thighs and half an onion"), things they're out of ("we're out of eggs") and corrections ("no wait, not the chicken"); Befana reads it and returns exactly what changed, plus `unsure` for anything that didn't read as an ingredient. Or pass `add` and `remove` as plain ingredient names. `replace: true` swaps everything fresh for the new list (staples stay). `staples` sets the always-on-hand list outright. For a photo of the fridge, freezer or a shelf, have the cook upload it (POST /api/upload with purpose "parse", or the pantry page's camera button) and pass the upload name as `photo`: Befana lists the food it can see, deletes the photo, and adds what it read (`unsure` holds what it couldn't make out). If you can see the photo yourself, read it and pass the names in `add` instead. The pantry isn't health data: the cook saying what they have is the yes, so save it and read the change back to them (one line). Never add anything the cook didn't say, and never suggest a brand. Every item is left off their shopping lists and counts toward suggest_from_pantry.

photo.description: An upload name (or its /media/ URL) from POST /api/upload with purpose "parse": a photo of the fridge or shelf to read

replace.description: Take out every fresh item not in this update (staples stay)

staples.description: Set the always-on-hand list to exactly these

name: update_pantry
title: Tell Befana what the cook has
